LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_origin.label: First Feather Law
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_origin.description: Cultivation in flower, sword and bow forms begins here.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_origin.levelDescript: Cultivation in flower, sword and bow forms begins here.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s1.label: Waking Edge
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s1.description: Each level increases sword-form attack damage by 3%.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s2.label: Trued String
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s2.description: Each level increases bow-form attack damage by 2%.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s3.label: Light Step
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s3.description: Each level increases movement speed by 0.08 tiles per second.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s4.label: Gleaming Edge
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s4.description: Each level increases sword-form armor penetration by 0.02.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s5.label: Warding Weave
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s5.description: Each level adds 0.03 sharp armor to equipment.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s5.levelDescriptions: Neiyu's unique attire gains +0.03 sharp armor when worn.
Neiyu's unique attire gains +0.06 sharp armor in total.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s6.label: Quick Nock
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s6.description: Each level reduces the cooldown of ordinary bow-form shots by 2%.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s7.label: Calm in Ji
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s7.description: Each level reduces incoming damage by 1.5%, multiplicatively.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s8.label: Forms in Tune
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s8.description: Ordinary attack damage in all three forms increases by 4%, multiplicative with other bonuses.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s8.levelDescriptions: Ordinary attack damage in all three forms increases by 4%, multiplicative with other bonuses.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s9.label: Set in Light
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s9.description: Ordinary sword and bow attacks deal an additional 3% damage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_s9.levelDescriptions: Ordinary sword and bow attacks deal an additional 3% damage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m1.label: Form Afterglow
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m1.description: Within 2 seconds of switching forms in combat, the first ordinary attack to hit and damage an enemy reduces the attack interval by 0.3 seconds. When a bow shot hits, Neiyu must still be on that weapon's attack cooldown to reduce the time remaining. Trigger cooldown: 4 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m1.levelDescriptions: Within 2 seconds of switching forms in combat, the first ordinary attack to hit and damage an enemy reduces the attack interval by 0.3 seconds. When a bow shot hits, Neiyu must still be on that weapon's attack cooldown to reduce the time remaining. Trigger cooldown: 4 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m2.label: Featherstep
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m2.description: After dodging an enemy melee attack, movement speed increases by 8% for 2 seconds. Trigger cooldown: 8 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m2.levelDescriptions: After dodging an enemy melee attack, movement speed increases by 8% for 2 seconds. Trigger cooldown: 8 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m3.label: Halo Mending
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m3.description: Roughly 40 seconds after leaving combat, the phase-two shield can regain 1 extra layer every 40 seconds, up to 25% of its current cap, rounded down. A cap of 24 layers, for example, allows this effect to restore up to 6 layers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m3.levelDescriptions: Roughly 40 seconds after leaving combat, the phase-two shield can regain 1 extra layer every 40 seconds, up to 25% of its current cap, rounded down. A cap of 24 layers, for example, allows this effect to restore up to 6 layers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m4.label: Riposte
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m4.description: A successful melee dodge opens a 3-second counterattack window. The first ordinary sword-form attack to hit an enemy in that window deals 10% more damage. Trigger cooldown: 12 seconds from the dodge.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m4.levelDescriptions: A successful melee dodge opens a 3-second counterattack window. The first ordinary sword-form attack to hit an enemy in that window deals 10% more damage. Trigger cooldown: 12 seconds from the dodge.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m5.label: Halo Memory
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m5.description: If an enemy attack hits the shield and it remains in phase two, keep the time already spent waiting for natural shield recovery. Trigger cooldown: 15 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m5.levelDescriptions: If an enemy attack hits the shield and it remains in phase two, keep the time already spent waiting for natural shield recovery. Trigger cooldown: 15 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m6.label: Flower to Blade
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m6.description: Switch directly from flower to sword form in combat. The first ordinary sword attack that hits and damages an enemy restores 1 layer to the phase-two shield. Trigger cooldown: 10 seconds. Switching forms again checks the transition anew.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m6.levelDescriptions: Switch directly from flower to sword form in combat. The first ordinary sword attack that hits and damages an enemy restores 1 layer to the phase-two shield. Trigger cooldown: 10 seconds. Switching forms again checks the transition anew.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m7.label: Breakaway
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m7.description: When an enemy breaks the shield, movement speed increases by 12% for 1.5 seconds. Trigger cooldown: 45 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m7.levelDescriptions: When an enemy breaks the shield, movement speed increases by 12% for 1.5 seconds. Trigger cooldown: 45 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m8.label: Feather Law Resonance
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m8.description: The cooldowns of the three effects triggered by switching forms are reduced by 15%.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m8.levelDescriptions: The cooldowns of the three effects triggered by switching forms are reduced by 15%.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m9.label: Last Feather
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m9.description: The first time an enemy breaks the shield in a fight, take 0.90× damage for 2 seconds if this node is ready. Trigger cooldown: 180 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_m9.levelDescriptions: The first time an enemy breaks the shield in a fight, take 0.90× damage for 2 seconds if this node is ready. Trigger cooldown: 180 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k1.label: Feather Arts
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k1.description: Opens the flower array, sword art and Flowfeather specializations. Required for Spring Breath, Echo and Volley.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k1.levelDescriptions: Opens the flower array, sword art and Flowfeather specializations. Required for Spring Breath, Echo and Volley.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k2.label: Spring Breath
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k2.description: Flower Array: Prayer of Life gains 0.5 tiles of radius around the chosen point. At foundation ranks 1/2/3, its radius becomes 4.5/5.5/6.5 tiles.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k2.levelDescriptions: Flower Array: Prayer of Life gains 0.5 tiles of radius around the chosen point. At foundation ranks 1/2/3, its radius becomes 4.5/5.5/6.5 tiles.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k3.label: Skyfall Echo
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k3.description: When Sword Art: Skyfall lands, it sends out a shockwave 1.5 tiles from the landing point. Enemies inside take 20% of the main strike's damage. At foundation ranks 1/2/3, the shockwave deals 12/18/24 damage before target-specific modifiers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k3.levelDescriptions: When Sword Art: Skyfall lands, it sends out a shockwave 1.5 tiles from the landing point. Enemies inside take 20% of the main strike's damage. At foundation ranks 1/2/3, the shockwave deals 12/18/24 damage before target-specific modifiers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k4.label: Volley
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k4.description: Flowfeather Rend fires 4 extra arrows per barrage, for 24/30/36 arrows at foundation ranks 1/2/3. Within a barrage, successive extra arrows hitting the same enemy deal 100%/50%/25%/12.5% damage. The sequence is tracked separately for each target.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k4.levelDescriptions: Flowfeather Rend fires 4 extra arrows per barrage, for 24/30/36 arrows at foundation ranks 1/2/3. Within a barrage, successive extra arrows hitting the same enemy deal 100%/50%/25%/12.5% damage. The sequence is tracked separately for each target.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k5.label: Lingering Prayer
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k5.description: Prayer of Life leaves a healing field in its original area for 3 seconds. Each second it heals non-hostile, non-mechanical units in the field, restoring 25% of each wound's remaining severity at the time of healing.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k5.levelDescriptions: Prayer of Life leaves a healing field in its original area for 3 seconds. Each second it heals non-hostile, non-mechanical units in the field, restoring 25% of each wound's remaining severity at the time of healing.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k6.label: Focused Beheading
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k6.description: Against a target whose posture is already broken, Sword Art: Beheading winds up 0.4 seconds faster. Use it before the default execution goes off to interrupt that execution and perform a quick Beheading instead.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k6.levelDescriptions: Against a target whose posture is already broken, Sword Art: Beheading winds up 0.4 seconds faster. Use it before the default execution goes off to interrupt that execution and perform a quick Beheading instead.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k7.label: Star-Seeking Arrows
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k7.description: The final 6 arrows in the barrage adjust their aim within 12° of the original direction and within range, favoring the standing enemy closest to the original landing point.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k7.levelDescriptions: The final 6 arrows in the barrage adjust their aim within 12° of the original direction and within range, favoring the standing enemy closest to the original landing point.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k8.label: Lingering Miasma
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k8.description: Flower Array: Miasma Garden lingers in its original area for 2 seconds. Each enemy newly entering the field gets the original food poisoning effect and rolls once for the 10% chance to go berserk.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k8.levelDescriptions: Flower Array: Miasma Garden lingers in its original area for 2 seconds. Each enemy newly entering the field gets the original food poisoning effect and rolls once for the 10% chance to go berserk.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k9.label: Hastened Thunder
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k9.description: Thunderseal Domain's first strike lands 0.3 seconds sooner after marking, changing the initial wait from 2–3 seconds to 1.7–2.7 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k9.levelDescriptions: Thunderseal Domain's first strike lands 0.3 seconds sooner after marking, changing the initial wait from 2–3 seconds to 1.7–2.7 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k10.label: Final Rain
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k10.description: When one of the final 6 arrows hits an enemy directly without being blocked by a shield, other enemies within 1.5 tiles of the impact take 15% of that arrow's damage. For extra arrows, apply the same-target damage reduction before calculating splash damage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k10.levelDescription: When one of the final 6 arrows hits an enemy directly without being blocked by a shield, other enemies within 1.5 tiles of the impact take 15% of that arrow's damage. For extra arrows, apply the same-target damage reduction before calculating splash damage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k11.label: Feather Finale
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k11.description: In one fight, cast an ability from each group: flower (Prayer of Life or Miasma Garden), sword (Skyfall or Beheading) and bow (Flowfeather Rend or Thunderseal Domain). The next form switch then grants 12% movement speed for 3 seconds. Trigger cooldown: 60 seconds, or 51 seconds after learning Feather Law Resonance.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_FeatherLaw_k11.levelDescription: In one fight, cast an ability from each group: flower (Prayer of Life or Miasma Garden), sword (Skyfall or Beheading) and bow (Flowfeather Rend or Thunderseal Domain). The next form switch then grants 12% movement speed for 3 seconds. Trigger cooldown: 60 seconds, or 51 seconds after learning Feather Law Resonance.
